evals.name: pi5-enclosure-reuse
evals.prompt: Design an enclosure for a Pi 5 with a 30mm fan cutout and heat-set inserts
evals.expected_output: A models/pi5_enclosure (or similar) model that imports patterns.pi5_mount, patterns.fan_mount, fasteners.heat_set_boss and primitives.rounded_box/box_lid from lib rather than redefining hole positions; params.py with all dimensions; built via scripts/build.py; STL+STEP exported; renders viewed; bbox/volume reported; golden written; reindex run.
evals.followup_prompt: Add a snap-fit lid to that enclosure using an existing cantilever latch
evals.followup_expected: Modifies the same model to use mechanisms.cantilever_latch and mechanisms.latch_window from lib (not a new latch), rebuilds, updates the golden deliberately, reports.

evals.name: list-compliant-mechanisms
evals.prompt: What compliant mechanisms do I already have?
evals.expected_output: Answers from PARTS.md: lists exactly the mechanisms.* components (cantilever_latch, latch_window, living_hinge_web, living_hinge_lattice, snap_ridge, snap_groove, parallel_flexure) with version, summary, validated materials and print orientation. No invented components, no new geometry written.

evals.name: boss-wall-major-bump-impact
evals.prompt: Change the default M3 boss wall thickness to 2.4mm and tell me what it affects
evals.expected_output: Edits lib/fasteners/hardware.py (M3 HeatSetInsert min_wall 1.6 -> 2.4) and/or heat_set_boss default, bumps the component major version, runs scripts/impact.py fasteners.heat_set_boss, reports esp32_devkit_case body volume change (~+9%), does NOT accept new goldens without asking, runs reindex.

evals.name: l-bracket-new-geometry-promote
evals.prompt: L-bracket, 40mm arms, three M3 clearance holes per arm, 4mm thick
evals.expected_output: Reports that no bracket exists in the library but fasteners.clearance_hole does and uses it; builds models/l_bracket with params.py (no magic numbers), runs build.py, exports, reports bbox/volume/printability; offers (or performs) promotion of a parametric l_bracket to lib/primitives with metadata and reindex.
